name: MSP_EEPROM_WRITE

payload_layout.note: In: no configuration payload. Refused while ARMED (MSP result error). On success the reply is a result-code ACK with no data. The save has real latency; the ACK is NOT proof the write completed. src/main/msp/msp.c lines 3299-3317 (blob 804d1dd3c9ee55cb0995f92352bac6d50911c671) @4.5.5.

verification.method: Reproduce against ade-mock-fc, then observe on a real board running Betaflight 4.5.5 once the hardware-write gate and bench unit exist.

licensing.note: Numeric interface constant read from a published pinned source and restated. No code, comments, tables, fixtures or error strings were copied.
